The UPSC CDS Final Result 2026 has been declared on 7th August 2026 by the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC). The final result is released for the candidates who have appeared in the Combined Defence Services (CDS) Examination (II), 2025 and then successfully cleared the Services Selection Board (SSB) interview. A total of 483 candidates have been selected for admission to the 124th Short Service Commission Course (Men and Women) at the Officers Training Academy (OTA), Chennai which will start in October 2026. You can now check their roll numbers and qualifying status in the official UPSC CDS Final Result PDF.

CDS Final Result 2026

The CDS Final Result is now released by the Union Public Service Commission for the admission to the 124th Short Service Commission (Men and Women) Courses at the Officers Training Academy (OTA), Chennai. The Government has notified 276 vacancies for the Men’s course and 19 vacancies for the Women’s course. The merit list has been prepared without considering the medical examination, and the candidature of all selected candidates remains provisional until the verification of age and educational qualifications by the Army Headquarters. Candidates will also be able to check their marks on the UPSC website within 15 days of the result declaration, and the marks will remain available for 30 days.

UPSC CDS Final Result 2026 Overview

The UPSC CDS Final Result 2026 is for the candidates who qualified in the Combined Defence Services (CDS) Examination (II), 2025 and the SSB interview. Check the important highlights of the result in the table below.

CDS Results 2026 PDF Download Link

The CDS Results 2026 PDF is released by the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) on its official website. Candidates who appeared for the CDS (II) 2025 examination and SSB interview can now download the final merit list PDF to check their selection status. The result pdf consists of names and roll numbers of all candidates who have cleared the admission to Officers Training Academy, Chennai. By clicking the link given below you can directly download UPSC CDS Final Result 2026 PDF.

Direct Link to Download UPSC CDS Final Result 2026 PDF

How to Check UPSC CDS Result 2026?

You can now easily check the UPSC CDS Result by visiting the official UPSC website. Just follow the simple steps below to download the result PDF and check your qualifying status.

  1. Go to the official website of UPSC.
  2. Then on the homepage, you can click on the “What’s New” or “Final Results” section.
  3. Then find and click on the link of “CDS Final Result 2026”.
  4. The result PDF will open on your screen.
  5. Press Ctrl + F and enter your Roll Number or Name.
  6. If your details appear in the PDF, you have qualified.
  7. Download the result PDF and save a copy for future reference.

How Can I Contact UPSC After the CDS Final Result 2026?

Candidates who have any queries regarding the UPSC CDS Final Result can contact the UPSC Facilitation Counter or the respective training academy. The Facilitation Counter is now available on working days as the UPSC Help Desk can be contacted by phone for assistance. The contact details are provided below.

What Next After CDS Final Result 2026?

Candidates whose name is going to appear in the CDS Merit List will then proceed with the remaining admission formalities. The selected candidates have to complete the medical examination and document verification which are conducted by the authorities. The final appointment will be fulfilled only after all eligibility conditions will be declared medically fit. After completing these formalities, candidates will then join the 124th Short Service Commission Course at the Officers Training Academy (OTA), Chennai as per the schedule.

FAQs on CDS Final Result 2026

Q1. When was the UPSC CDS Final Result 2026 declared?
The UPSC CDS Final Result 2026 was declared on 7th August 2026.

Q2. How many candidates have qualified in the CDS Final Result 2026?
A total of 483 candidates have been qualified in the CDS Final Merit List.

Q3. Where can I download the CDS Result 2026 PDF?
The candidates can download CDS Result PDF from the official website of UPSC i.e. upsc.gov.in.

Q4. When will the UPSC release CDS 2026 marks?
The UPSC CDS marks will be available within 15 days of the final result declaration and it will remain online for 30 days.

Q5. What happens after the CDS Final Result 2026?
The eligible candidates have to undergo medical test and verification of documents before joining the course in the OTA Chennai.
